item.title: House Democrats Say 'Hell No' To Funding ICE
item.description: House Democrats are reportedly a strong NO on providing any votes to fund ICE which means that Mike Johnson will have a one vote majority and have to figure it out on his own.

item.title: Could This Whistleblower Complaint Bring Down The Trump White House?
item.description: A whistleblower complaint against Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard that implicates another cabinet official and executive privilege is so allegedly damaging that it's locked down.

item.title: Democrats Say Trump's Bill To Takeover And Nationalize Voting Is DEAD
item.description: When Trump went on Dan Bongino's show and said that Republicans should takeover the voting and nationalize elections. he was talking about the SAVE ACT which Senate Democrats say is DOA.

item.title: Trevor Noah Triggered A Trump Oval Office Meltdown Over Epstein
item.description: Donald Trump called reporters into the White House to whine about Trevor Noah's Grammys joke about Trump and Jeffrey Epstein and practically begged America to move on from the Epstein files.

item.title: Bernie Sanders Nails Trump For Wasting $38 Million To Weaken Civil Rights
item.description: A new Government Accountability Office (GAO) report commissioned by Sen. Bernie Sanders (I-VT) found that Trump wasted $38 million in taxpayer money while weakening the civil rights of students.

item.title: Bombshell House Oversight Report Finds Trump Is Obstructing Justice In Minnesota ICE Murders
item.description: The Trump administration is reportedly going beyond smearing ICE murder victims Renee Good and Alex Pretti. The administration is obstructing justice according to a House Oversight Democrats report.

item.title: Trump Just Made The Most Insane Statement About Elections In The History Of The Oval Office
item.description: A reporter asked Trump where he thought the federal government should take over elections, and his response was not just ignorant and incompetent. It was also insane.

item.title: House Democrat Breaks The Treasury Secretary By Demanding He Investigate Apparent UAE Crypto Bribe To Trump
item.description: Rep. Gregory Meeks (D-NY) confronted Treasury Sec. Scott Bessent and asked him if he would investigate an apparent bribe to Trump via crypto from the UAE and told him to stop being a flunky.

item.title: Democrats Are Winning And Just Made A Game Changing Demand On ICE Reform
item.description: Chuck Schumer and Hakeem Jeffries talked to reporters after their strategy meeting on reining in ICE, and they have added a new demand to their list of reforms they require for ICE to be funded.

item.title: Trump Goes Into Hiding As His Approval Rating Crashes
item.description: With his unpopularity growing by the day, Donald Trump is avoiding public events where he could be humiliated.
